The client platform at 80%, and table cells that stay in their column

Pictures of the real platform at a 1440-wide and a 1280-wide screen, with the change applied. Five business units are given long names and "Objectives & actions" so the table looks like the one you sent. Nothing here is built yet.

1 · What spills today

Measured on the page: the Plans in cell runs 30px into the next column on a 1440 screen and 46px on a 1280 one, because "Objectives & actions" and its count are held on one line. The Key Objectives heading runs into Weight.

2 · The whole client platform at 80% on a computer

The console's rule, applied to the client platform: every page is drawn at 80% of its size on a screen 1000px or wider, so everything keeps its proportions and more fits across. A phone stays at full size, where 80% would make the words too small to read.

3 · And a cell never spills, at any size

80% alone still leaves "Plans in" 12px over on a 1280 screen, and a client with a longer word for how it plans would spill again. So two small changes go with it:

ChangeWhat you see
The count drops under the wordWhen "Plans in" has no room for the word and its count on one line, the count goes on a second line in the same cell, as on the 1280 picture. Where there is room, it stays beside the word.
Three columns rebalancedShown in the nav gives up a little (14% to 11%, it holds a short name). Plans in gets 13% and Key Objectives 10%, so that heading stays on one line.

Measured with both: nothing spills and no heading overlaps, at 1280 or 1440.

4 · What the build also has to correct

A zoomed page shrinks anything set to the window's height, and anything placed by its position on the screen lands in the wrong place unless it is corrected. The console needed both fixes. On the client platform that means the Setup list and other full-height panels (in the pictures above the Setup list stops short of the bottom; that is fixed in the build), plus the menus, drop-down lists, hover labels, the people list under a cell, the date pickers and the question boxes. Each one is corrected and checked at 80%.

What you would be agreeing to

  1. The whole client platform at 80% on a computer (1000px wide and up), as the console is; phones unchanged.
  2. On Business units, Plans in drops its count under the word when there is no room, and the three columns are rebalanced so nothing spills and the Key Objectives heading fits.
  3. Full-height panels and everything placed on the screen are corrected for the zoom and checked.
